content.rendered:
“And when he saw them, he said unto them, Go shew yourselves unto the priests…”
-Luke 17 vs. 14

That is the Focal Scripture of Streams of Joy Devotional today.

In Leviticus 14, scriptures outlined the process of re-integrating lepers into the society. If a leper got healed, he/she went to meet the priests. There needed to be healing before meeting the priest. Healing was a prerequisite before meeting the priest.

The ten lepers were yet to be healed, but Jesus sent them to the priests. Jesus sent them to the priests without following the protocol for such meeting. The lepers entered the city when their healing was pending. Jesus waved a protocol for the ten lepers.

Friend, God is about to break protocols in order to move you forward. You may not be good enough for some opportunities, you may be far from certain higher levels you desire, but God will show you mercy and wave protocols you can’t deal with. God will remove the roadblocks in your journey to greatness.

The lepers didn’t break protocols by themselves; Jesus broke it for them. You may not be able to tamper with protocols that are against you, but if Jehovah is involved, He will tamper with the processes and protocols of men and make you smile beyond expectations.

Jesus didn’t take permission from anyone before breaking protocols for the lepers. When God breaks protocols for you, He won’t need the opinion of haters, and no man can stop or divert your package.

Pray With Me: Lord, break human protocols for my sake, in Jesus’ name!

Enjoy A Restful Saturday.
